name: Tight
description: Side margins of about 5.5% of the width. Type runs close to the edge: urgent, packed, poster-like. Use when the headline should feel huge.

name: Standard
description: Side margins of about 6.7% of the width: the classic poster margin. Balanced and calm; the safe default.

name: Airy
description: Side margins of about 9% of the width. More paper around everything: quiet, premium, gallery-like. The headline gets smaller to fit.
